description: Canonical Port OS plugin dispatch error. This contract is used when a plugin reports a third-party service, bridge, or device failure during message dispatch. It is inspired by Alexa-style error responses, but the type and family values are Port OS-specific.

code.description: Opaque plugin or provider debug code suitable for support.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the plugin dispatch failure.
message.example: The living room bridge is offline.
